name: Lemonade OG social card — 'Forget Everything You Know About Insurance' by lemonade.com
description: A 1200×630 social card split roughly in half: the left column stacks a script wordmark above a three-line serif headline, while the right half is occupied by a single monochrome line-art scene (house, bench, person, dog) that bleeds to the canvas edges. The palette is strictly greyscale — charcoal type on white, illustration strokes and flat fills in light grey — with a thin light-grey band along the bottom acting as a ground line that the illustration's shadows sit on. Hierarchy is handled purely by scale and weight contrast: the oversized serif headline reads first, the friendly script logo second, the illustration third, all without a single accent colour.
